verdict.rationale: Khoj documents agents with custom knowledge, persona, chat model and tools (khoj-gh-1) and custom system prompts (khoj-docs-12). Admins can add multiple agents for different use-cases such as Writer or Researcher (khoj-docs-26), which covers distinct agents with their own prompts, models and knowledge. The routing half of the story is not evidenced: nothing documents routing conversations or channels (e.g., WhatsApp) to a specific agent, and per-agent workspace isolation is only implied by 'custom knowledge'. Missing for 10: documented per-conversation/per-channel routing to agents, explicit per-agent workspace isolation, independent hands-on corroboration of multi-agent use.
